senses.gloss:
n. (-कं)
Water.
E.
see उदक, the initial vowel being dropped.

m. (-कः)
1 A donor, one who makes presents, especially to Brahmans.
2 A sacrificer, one who pays all the expenses of the ceremony, and employs the officiating priests.
E.
दा to give, क Uṇādi aff.

r. 1st cl. (दक्षते)
1 To grow or increase.
2 To dispatch, to expedite, to do quickly.
3 To go, to move.
4 To hurt or kill.

mfn. (-क्षः-क्षा-क्षं)
Clever, able, dexterous.
m. (-क्षः)
1 A Brahmādika; according to one legend, son of BRAHMĀ, born from the thumb of his right hand, for the purpose of peopling the world: according to another, he is the son of the Munis, called Prācetasas. DAKṢA had sixty daughters, of whom twenty-seven are the nymphs who form the lunar asterisms, and wives of the moon; one of his daughters also was SATI or DURGĀ, the wife of ŚIVA; and seventeen were married to KAŚYAPA, and were the mothers of all created beings. DAKṢA was on one occasion decapitated by ŚIVA: see दक्षाध्वरध्वंसकृत्; he is sometimes regarded as an Avatāra of BRAHMĀ himself. []
2 A Muni and legislator, who flourished in the beginning of the Tretā Yuga.
3 A kind of tree.
4 The bull of ŚIVA.
5 A cock.
6 A scholar, a Paṇḍita.
7 A dexterous or clever man.
8 ŚIVA.
9 A name of Agni of fire.
10 A general lover, one attached to many mistresses.
f. (-क्षा)
The earth.
E.
दक्ष to grow or increase, affix अच्.

f. (-न्या)
A name of DURGĀ.
E.
दक्ष, and कन्या the maiden, the daughter of DAKṢA, who in this case seems to be identified with Himāla, the snowy mountain.

f. (-जा)
1 The goddess DURGĀ.
9 A lunar asterism.
E.
दक्ष, and जा born: see the preceding.

m. (-तिः)
1 The moon.
2 The deity ŚIVA.
E.
दक्षजा a lunar asterism or DURGĀ, and पति husband.

f. (-ता)
Dexterity, cleverness.
E.
तल् added to दक्ष; also with त्व, दक्षत्वं.

m. (-ज्ञः)
The sacrifice made by DAKṢA.
E.
दक्ष, and यज्ञ sacrifice.

f. (-नी)
DURGA.
E.
दक्षयज्ञ, and विनाशिनी destructress.

m. (-र्णिः)
The ninth Manu.

m. (-कृत्)
A name of ŚIVA.
E.
दक्ष the Brahmādika, as DAKṢA, अध्वर a sacrifice, ध्वंसकृत् subduer or disturber: DAKṢA having on one occasion made a sacrifice, to which he invited all the gods, except his son-in law ŚIVA, and his wife SATI, the latter went unbid, and being received coolly, threw herself into the fire; an emanation of ŚIVA, proceeded against DAKṢA, and an affray ensued, in which the gods and Ṛṣis were maltreated and dispersed, and DAKṢA decapitated; he was restored to life, and the head of a ram substituted for the one he had lost.

m. (-य्यः)
1 The bird of VIṢṆU, Garuḍa.
2 A vulture.
E.
दक्ष to hurt, आय्य Uṇādi aff.

m. (-य्यः)
A vulture.
E.
दक्षा to be quick, आय्य affix, and again, अण् affix of descent.

mfn. (-णः-णा-णं)
1 Candid, sincere, honest, upright.
2 Right, (not left.)
3 South, southern.
4 Dependent, subject.
5 Clever, able, dexterous.
f. (-णा)
1 A present to Brahmans, upon solemn or sacrificial occasions.
2 The south.
3 Completion of any rite, fixing or establishing any act or place.
4 A form or figure of DURGĀ, in which the right side is said to be advanced.
5 Donation to Brahmans, personified as a goddess, said to be born from KṚṢṆA'S right side.
E.
दक्ष to prosper, &c. Uṇādi affix इनन्.

mfn. (-णः-णी-णं)
Relating or belonging to the south, to a gift to Brahmans, &c.
E.
दक्षिण, and अण् aff.

f. (-का)
A form of DURGĀ worshipped by the Tāntrikas.
E.
दक्षिण, and कालिका a form of the same.

ind.
Southward, southerly.
E.
तसि added to दक्षिण.

n. (-थं)
1 The south.
2 Southern road or course.
E.
दक्षिण, and पथ for पथिन् path.

m. (-थः)
The south, the southern direction or quarter.
E.
दक्षिणा, and पथ for पथिन् path.

f. (-र्व्वा)
The south-east quarter.
E.
दक्षिण south, and पूर्व्व east.

mfn. (-स्थः-स्था-स्थं)
Upon the right side, to the south, &c.
m. (-स्थः)
A charioteer.
E.
दक्षिण as above, and स्थ who stays or abides.

m. (-ग्निः)
One kind of sacred fire, that which is taken from the domestic or consecrated fire, and is placed to the south.
E.
दक्षिण south, and अग्नि fire.

mfn. (-ग्रः-ग्रा-ग्रं)
Pointing to the south, having the head or top to the south.
E.
दक्षिण, and अग्र end.

m. (-लः)
The Malaya mountain.
E.
दक्षिण south, and अचल mountain.

m. (-रः)
A worshipper of Śakti according to the purer or right-hand ritual.
E.
दक्षिण, and आचार observance.

ind.
Southward.
E.
the fifth case of दक्षिण, used as a particle.

m. (-यः)
A southern, or an inhabitant of the south.
E.
दक्षिण, अत्यय who goes to or beyond.

m. (-न्मा)
A southern, or the Andhakas, Guhas, Pulindas, Savaras, Cucukas, and Madrapas, all outcaste or barbarous tribes.
E.
दक्षिणापथ, and जन्मन् birth.

mfn. (-णः-णा-णं)
Declining, shelving or inclining to the south.
E.
दक्षिणा, and प्रवण declivity.

mfn. (-खः-खी-खं)
Turning the face south wards.
E.
दक्षिण south, and मुख the face, with आङ् prefixed.

n. (-नं)
The sun's progress south of the equator, the winter solstice.
E.
दक्षिण, and अयन going.

n. (-ण्यं)
The peninsula, the great southern forest.
E.
दक्षिण, and अरण्य a wood.

mfn. (-र्हः-र्हा-र्हं)
Meriting a reward.
E.
दक्षिण a present, and अर्ह fit for.

m. (-र्त्तः)
A conch shell with the valve opening to the right.
E.
दक्षिण, and आवर्त्त a turn.

f. (-की)
A line of bees.
E.
दक्षिण, and आवर्त्तक turning.

f. (-शा)
The south.
E.
दक्षिण, and आशा quarter.

m. (-तिः)
A name of YAMA.
E.
दक्षिण south, आशा quarter, and पति master or regent.

mfn. (-यः-या-यं)
Meriting a reward.
E.
दक्षिण a present or reward, affix च्छ.

ind.
Southward, southerly.
E.
the third case of दक्षिण, used as a particle.

m. (-र्म्मा)
A deer struck by a hunter.
E.
दक्षिण the right side, and इर्म्म wound, comp. irr.

mfn. (-ण्यः-ण्या-ण्यं)
Meriting a reward.
E.
दक्षिण a present, and यत् aff.

mfn. (-ण्यः-ण्या-ण्यं)
Meriting a reward.
n. (-ण्यं)
1 Concord, harmony, agreement.
2 Cleverness. talent.
3 Appeasing or restoring any one offended to good humour.
E.
दक्षिणा a gift, &c. affix ण्यत्.

n. (-कं)
A multitude of the descendants of DAKṢA.
E.
दक्ष, and वुञ् aff.

mfn. (-णः-णी-णं)
Of or relating to DAKṢA, a descendant, &c.
n. (-णं)
Gold, or a gold ornament, as an earring, &c.
E.
दक्ष, and फञ् aff.

mfn. (-णी-णिनी-णि)
Having gold.
m. (-णी)
A Brahman student, wearing gold earrings.
E.
दाक्षायण, and इनि aff.

f. plu. (-यिण्यः)
The twenty-seven lunar mansions, considered mythologically as the daughters of DAKṢA, and wives of the moon.
f. sing. (-णी)
A name of DURGĀ.
2 The nymph and asterism ROHIṆĪ.
3 A plant, commonly Dantī, (Croton polyandrum.)
4 A lunar asterism in general.
E.
दक्ष the son of BRAHMA, so called, फिञ् affix of descent, and ङीप् fem. aff.

m. (-पः)
1 CANDRA.
2 ŚIVA.
E.
दाक्षायिणी, and प who protects.

m. (-तिः)
CANDRA or the moon.
E.
दाक्षायिणी an asterism, and पति husband: see the preceding; also similar compounds.

m. (-णः)
The moon: see the last.
E.
दाक्षायिणी, and रमण lover.

f. (-न्था)
A place in the north of India, in the country of Vāhlika or Balkh: see कन्थ.

mfn. (-यः-या-यं)
Produced or born, &c. in Dākṣikantha; see the last.
E.
दाक्षिकन्थ, and छ affix; also similar compounds, as दाक्षिनगरीय, दाक्षिग्रामीय.

mfn. (-त्यः-त्या-त्यं)
Southerly, southern, belonging to or produced in the south.
m. (-त्यः)
The cocoanut.
E.
दाक्षिण southern, and त्यक् aff.

m. (-त्त्रः)
The inspired grammarian PĀṆINI.
E.
दाक्षी a proper name, the mother of the saint, and पुत्त्र a son.

m. (-यः)
A name of PĀṆINI.
E.
दाक्षी the mother of the Muni, and ढक् affix of descent.

n. (-क्ष्यं)
Cleverness, dexterity, ability.
E.
दक्ष, and यञ् aff.
